Bra Size to Bust Size Chart: Approximate Reference

A quick reference showing how underbust, bust difference and starting cup size relate. Use measurements as a starting point and verify fit in the garment.

Approximate Bust Reference by Band

The table uses the site's simple one-inch cup-difference convention. Values are approximate reference points rather than guaranteed body measurements for a labeled bra size.

Frequently Asked Questions

Answers about sizing methods, measurements, and fit considerations.

Can two people with the same bust circumference wear different bra sizes? ▾

Yes. Bra size depends on both ribcage and bust measurements, and fit also depends on breast shape and the construction of the bra.

Sources & Standards

  • ISO 8559-1:2017, Size designation of clothes — Part 1: Anthropometric definitions for body measurement
